Definition: to hold aloof, i.e. (intransitivey) abstain (from food and drink, from impurity, and even from divine worship (i.e. apostatize)); specifically, to set apart (to sacred purposes), i.e. devote
BiblicalUsage: 1) to dedicate, consecrate, separate; 1a) (Niphal) to dedicate oneself, devote oneself; 1b) (Hiphil) to keep sacredly separate; 2)(Hiphil) to be a Nazarite, live as a Nazarite
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
